description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named ExpandableList1, demonstrating the use of expandable lists with custom adapter. It includes methods for creating the activity, handling context menus, and an inner class implementing a custom expandable list adapter with sample data.

classes.name: ExpandableList1
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating expandable list usage with custom adapter, handling context menus and user interactions.

classes.name: MyExpandableListAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseExpandableListAdapter, providing sample data and views for expandable list items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the adapter, and registers context menu on the expandable list view.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates a context menu with a sample action when user long-presses an item.

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection of context menu items, identifies the clicked item, and displays corresponding Toast messages.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns data for a specific child item in the expandable list.

methods.name: getChildId
methods.description: Returns the ID for a specific child item.

methods.name: getChildrenCount
methods.description: Returns the number of children in a given group.

methods.name: getGenericView
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured TextView for list items.

methods.name: getChildView
methods.description: Provides the view for a specific child item in the list.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns data for a specific group.

methods.name: getGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of groups.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID for a group.

methods.name: getGroupView
methods.description: Provides the view for a specific group in the list.

methods.name: isChildSelectable
methods.description: Indicates whether a child item is selectable.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether the IDs are stable across changes.
